mostWorthwhile.text: Separating the copied chromosomes was most worthwhile: the result distinguishes sister-chromatid separation from division of the shared cytoplasm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making membrane vesicles was a less informative intermediate. The later growth picture shows more cytoplasm and organelles, but does not make the vesicles' contribution to those contents explicit.

surprise.text: The copied-genome result clarified that replication includes noncoding DNA, not just sequences used to make proteins.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining phospholipids with new proteins to make vesicles was a less obvious connection before the result.

continue.text: Yes. I would be interested to see how cells with the same genome develop different structures through gene expression, although the later steps here offered little choice beyond following the sole combination.
